description: The diff config-sync's admin page shows, from the real plugin: each entry that differs between config/sync and the database (`different`, `only-in-db`, `only-in-sync-dir`), what differs in a few words, and its `likelyDirection` (import | export | unknown) from the file's git history. It includes what a Strapi start changes by itself: after changing a schema, a controller or a route, export those entries and commit them with the code. It loads the project's Strapi the way config-sync's CLI does, which writes to the database as a `strapi develop` start does (schema sync, migrations): a local development database only — a remote one, or a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, is refused first. A few seconds.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

key.description: One entry, `<type>.<name>`: every difference, and both sides when they fit.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

name: config_sync_diff
title: config-sync: the real diff between config/sync and the database
